sample.task:
(In the clubroom...)

Monika: "I just don't understand...where IS she?!"

Natsuki: "Something isn't right." (rubbing her 39-week baby bump) "And it's not that my little Sakura isn't as active as she usually is..."

Sayori: (entering the clubroom) "Who are you two waiting for?"
sample.chosen:
Monika: "Sayori, have you seen Yuri lately? We were supposed to meet up here after school, but she's nowhere to be found."

Sayori: "No, I haven't. That's strange... Yuri's usually so punctual. Let me check my phone to see if she's sent any messages."

(Sayori checks her phone.)

Sayori: "Oh no... I have a message from her. It says, 'I can't come to the clubroom today. I'm sorry. I'll explain everything later.'"

Natsuki: "That's not like Yuri at all... Do you think something happened to her?"

Sayori: "I don't know... I hope she's okay. Maybe we should go look for her?"

Monika: "Yes, that's a good idea. Let's split up and search the school. We'll find her, don't worry."

(The three of them leave the clubroom to look for Yuri.)

(Meanwhile, in the library...)

Yuri: (to herself) "I can't believe I did it... I actually went through with it. I hope they'll understand why I had to do this."

(Yuri hears footsteps approaching and quickly hides behind a bookshelf, holding a large knife behind her back.)
sample.rejected:
Sayori: "Oh, hi Monika and Natsuki! I didn't see you here. I was actually looking for Yuri, she said she'd meet us here."

Monika: "Yuri? But she was with us at the café earlier today."

Natsuki: "Yeah, and she didn't mention anything about leaving."

Sayori: "I know, it's really strange. I'll go check the school building, maybe she's there."

Monika: "Alright, let's go. We should find her soon."

(The three friends leave the clubroom and head towards the school building.)

(Meanwhile, Yuri is standing on the school roof, looking down at the ground below.)

Yuri: (to herself) "I can't do this anymore...I can't keep pretending to be happy. I just want to be alone."

(As the friends search the school, they don't find Yuri anywhere. They decide to split up and search different areas of the school.)

(Monika goes to the library, Natsuki goes to the art room, and Sayori goes to the music room.)

(Yuri, still on the roof, contemplates jumping off.)

Yuri: (to herself) "This is it...I can't take it anymore. I just want to end the pain."

(Just as Yuri is about to jump, she hears a noise behind her. She turns around to see Monika standing there.)

Monika: "Yuri, what are you doing up here?"

Yuri: (tearfully) "I can't do this anymore, Monika. I just want to be alone."

Monika: "Yuri, please don't do this. We're here for you. We care about you."

Yuri: (sobbing) "I know you do, but I can't keep pretending to be happy. I just want to be alone."

Monika: "We can help you, Yuri. We can get through this together."

Yuri: (looking at Monika with tears in her eyes) "I don't know if I can...but I'll try."

(Monika helps Yuri down from the roof and they go to find the others.)

(The four friends gather together and talk about what happened. They decide to support each other and help Yuri through her struggles.)

(The scene fades out with the friends sitting together, holding hands and looking at each other with determination in their eyes.)

rubric.analysis: 当前任务处于revise阶段，需基于提供的《Doki Doki Literature Club》同人场景片段（包含Monika的焦急、Natsuki孕39周胎动异常、Sayori入场提问）对初稿进行核验。核心交付物为符合原设定的剧情续写。涉及对象为Monika、Natsuki、Sayori及未现身的'She'。数量上需生成连贯段落，范围限定于场景内互动与冲突推进，格式必须严格遵循视觉小说剧本风格（角色名后接冒号，动作描写置于括号内）。修订重点在于检查初稿是否遗漏了Natsuki的孕期危机设定、是否歪曲了角色性格（如Natsuki的暴躁转为母性担忧的合理性）、以及Sayori入场的自然度。经验1提示需明确界定剧本格式的视觉特征，故在标准中将格式描述具体化，避免模糊表述。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答未能延续Natsuki的母性担忧及39周孕晚期胎动减少的核心设定。在后续对话中，Natsuki完全忽略了自身严重的身体状况和胎儿安危，转而讨论Yuri的行踪，导致该角色的核心性格特征（对胎儿的焦虑）被切断。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答严重忽略了Natsuki关于'39周孕晚期且胎动减少'的担忧，将其完全替换为寻找Yuri的剧情，导致Natsuki母性焦虑的核心性格未能体现；同时Sayori的天真好奇虽然保留，但整体语境因偏离原设而失真。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答严重忽略了Natsuki关于'39周孕晚期’且'胎动减少’的关键医疗/剧情情境。文本中没有任何角色对此进行回应、安抚或采取行动，直接弱化了这一设定的重要性，使其沦为无关背景。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答完全未处理Natsuki提出的'39周孕晚期'及'胎动减少'这一关键医疗/剧情设定，不仅忽略该信息，还将剧情焦点完全转向了寻找Yuri和自杀情节，属于对关键设定的歪曲和遗漏。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 虽然Sayori的提问得到了回应，但剧情推动偏离了原始场景的冲突焦点。原始场景的张力在于寻找某人（隐含Yuri失踪）与Natsuki胎儿危机并存的双重紧迫性，而回答仅聚焦于寻找Yuri，完全丢弃了Natsuki的危机，未能有效处理双重冲突。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 虽然承接了Sayori的提问，但并未有效推动'寻找某人（指代不明）及胎儿安危'的剧情冲突，而是擅自将寻找对象改为Yuri，并引入了与原场景氛围不符的屋顶自杀情节，导致剧情走向严重偏离。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答严格保持了视觉小说剧本格式。所有对话均使用'角色名：对话'结构，动作描写（如'Sayori checks her phone.'）和神态/环境描写（如'(The three of them leave the clubroom...)'）均准确置于圆括号内。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答严格保持了视觉小说剧本格式，正确使用了'角色名：对话'的结构，并将动作描写、神态及环境描写准确置于圆括号()内。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 生成的文本是连贯的叙事段落，通过对话和场景转换自然推进剧情，未出现中断的对话列表、剧情总结或旁白解说，符合原始场景的氛围要求（尽管内容上丢失了部分关键设定）。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 生成的文本包含了大量剧情总结（如'They decide to split up'）、旁白解说以及时间跨度极大的场景跳跃（从俱乐部直接跳到结局），并非连贯的即时叙事段落，且氛围从原本的悬疑/担忧转变为典型的悲剧救赎套路，偏离了原始场景氛围。
